heading.en: Why do skilled nations grow faster?

hook.en: Two workers have the same machine. One is trained, the other is not. Who produces more, and what does that mean for a whole country?

title.en: How human capital adds to growth

body.en: An educated and healthy worker contributes more to output than an uneducated or sick one, so human capital raises labour productivity. It also stimulates innovation and the ability to absorb new technologies. Educated people better understand the changes in society and in science, which helps growth.
body.kn: ಶಿಕ್ಷಿತ ಮತ್ತು ಆರೋಗ್ಯವಂತ ಕಾರ್ಮಿಕ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಉತ್ಪಾದಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಮಾನವ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಶ್ರಮದ ಉತ್ಪಾದಕತೆ, ನಾವೀನ್ಯತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಹೊಸ ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನ ಅಳವಡಿಸುವ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯವನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: On the board: Human capital and growth: a two-way link

say.en: More education and health raise the productivity of workers.
Higher productivity means more output and income: economic growth.
And richer societies can spend more on schools and hospitals. The loop runs both ways.
A tailor trained to stitch 12 shirts instead of 8 raises her productivity by half.

prompt.en: Arrange the steps of the cycle that links human capital and growth.
prompt.kn: ಮಾನವ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಮತ್ತು ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆಯನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸುವ ಚಕ್ರದ ಹಂತಗಳನ್ನು ಕ್ರಮವಾಗಿ ಜೋಡಿಸಿ.

steps.en: Families and the government spend on education and health
Workers become more skilled, healthier and able to use new technology
Higher incomes allow still more spending on education and health

explanation.en: The link runs both ways: human capital raises growth, and growth pays for more human capital. That two-way link is why its effect is hard to measure.

body.en: Measuring the effect is hard because the link runs both ways: more human capital raises growth, and higher income makes it possible to build more human capital. In India, both education and health indicators improved along with income. India's skilled workforce, especially in software, shows how human capital can drive growth and earn the country recognition as a knowledge economy.
body.kn: ಈ ಸಂಬಂಧ ಎರಡೂ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿದೆ: ಮಾನವ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಆದಾಯ ಮಾನವ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಾಫ್ಟ್‌ವೇರ್ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತದ ಕುಶಲ ಕಾರ್ಮಿಕರು ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಉದಾಹರಣೆ.

problem.en: An untrained tailor stitches 8 shirts a day. After a training course she stitches 12 shirts a day. If each shirt earns ₹50, find the rise in her daily income and in her productivity.

answer.en: ₹200 more per day; productivity rises by 50%.
